::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** May 9th 1890  
**From:** Torquay  
**Manuscript:** MS Bodleian Library Benson C.5.4 3/64 fol. 98
:::

Dear [Miss Benson](people/person_1858.qmd),
Thank you for letting me know. I am wandering as you see, but you will soon hear from the publisher
Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

I hope you have another story for me –
